name: The majority voted against an amendment to the usual [second reading motion](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/). It would have added the words below to the usual second reading motion, which is "that [the bill](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6657) be read for a second time" (parliamentary jargon for agreeing with the main idea of the bill).
